heroStages.headline: Specialist-led Retina & Cataract Eye Care
heroStages.description: Expert evaluation and personalised eye care for retina, cataract, diabetic eye disease, ROP and comprehensive ophthalmology in Bhopal.
heroStages.subDetail: Equipped for delicate microsurgery and comprehensive medical retina management under Dr Sandhya Gaur.

heroStages.headline: Cataract Surgery — Phaco & SICS
heroStages.description: Modern micro-incision cataract surgery with premium intraocular lens options, backed by AIIMS training and published research on advanced IOL power calculation.
heroStages.subDetail: Day-care stitchless phacoemulsification with rapid visual recovery.

heroStages.headline: Vitreoretinal Surgery — Vitrectomy
heroStages.description: Advanced sutureless vitrectomy for retinal detachment, macular hole, vitreous haemorrhage, diabetic complications and complex posterior-segment disease.
heroStages.subDetail: Ultra-high speed sutureless micro-incision vitrectomy surgery (MIVS 25G/27G).

heroStages.headline: Medical Retina, Lasers & Injections
heroStages.description: Comprehensive care for diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration (AMD) and retinal vein occlusion — retinal laser photocoagulation and anti-VEGF intravitreal injections.
heroStages.subDetail: High-definition optical coherence tomography (OCT) and targeted anti-VEGF therapy under strict aseptic protocols.

heroStages.headline: Comprehensive Eye Evaluation
heroStages.description: Meticulous, dilated examination of the full visual pathway — from cornea to optic nerve — with modern retinal imaging for early, accurate diagnosis.
heroStages.subDetail: Comprehensive screening for glaucoma, ischemic neuropathies, and vascular changes.

heroStages.headline: Uveitis & Inflammatory Eye Disease
heroStages.description: Specialist diagnosis and treatment of uveitis — inflammation of the iris, ciliary body and choroid — including infective, autoimmune and paediatric uveitis, managed with targeted medical therapy.
heroStages.subDetail: Systemic multi-disciplinary workup for complex ocular inflammation.

heroStages.headline: ROP — Retinopathy of Prematurity
heroStages.description: Dedicated screening and timely laser / injection treatment of Retinopathy of Prematurity for premature and low-birth-weight babies — protecting the tiniest eyes in Bhopal.
heroStages.subDetail: Time-sensitive bedside neonatal retina screening adhering to national AIIMS protocols.

technology.title: Microsurgical Technology & Aseptic OT
technology.description: Delicate ophthalmic structures demand sub-micron imaging and precision fluidics to maximize patient visual recovery.

items.title: 25G / 27G Sutureless Vitrectomy
items.desc: High-speed pneumatic cut rates with micro-cannulas for retinal detachment repair, macular holes, and diabetic vitreous hemorrhage with rapid healing.

items.title: Carl Zeiss Optics & Spectral OCT
items.desc: Stereoscopic high-depth red reflex visualization and micron-level optical coherence tomography for early detection of retinal disorders.

items.title: Class 100 HEPA Clean Air OT
items.desc: Modular positive-pressure laminar airflow with 99.97% bacterial air filtration for ultra-sterile microsurgical safety and zero endophthalmitis.
